leaves.leaf: five-value bf16 Q/K and strictly increasing float32 score control
leaves.replaces: real QSA index_qk_proj outputs and compressed key cache from the checkpoint
leaves.equivalence: more convenient; creates boundary ties and a tie-free control, does not measure checkpoint tie rate

leaves.leaf: two serialized peers on one CUDA device with separate output buffers
leaves.replaces: two concurrently scheduled TP worker processes and their local output buffers
leaves.equivalence: more convenient; tests pinned selection determinism on identical scores, not TP process timing or actual cross-rank score identity

leaves.leaf: CUDA sleep on a second stream during the concurrent-load phase
leaves.replaces: real model and other GPU work competing with QSA selection
leaves.equivalence: more convenient; receipt records whether the load event was incomplete at each top-k submission, not model-equivalent contention

leaves.replaces: qsa_select_paged_prefill wrapper in the QSA indexer forward path
leaves.equivalence: same pinned score and top-k functions with the wrapper's 64-row geometry, visible-block vector, logits width and workspace; omits model-side projection and later attention

leaves.leaf: CPU byte hashes and sorted index sets after CUDA synchronization
leaves.replaces: no production leaf; diagnostic readback only
leaves.equivalence: observability only, after each pinned kernel completes
